specification: WINGA GROWTH LOOPS & NETWORK EFFECTS v1.0

lastVerifiedRelease.verification: historical prior-turn build/source/health evidence; not a current human canary

overall.evidenceRule: Source present/prepared is not live acceptance; previous synthetic/CI results do not override the current blocker.

securitySnapshot.provenance: Exact historical source scan, not independent approval or review of subsequent source changes.

workItems.title: Canonical Messages readiness
workItems.evidence: User reported Messages incomplete on 2026-10-13. Internal product sharing, native Room participation and confirmed message value are not live-accepted.
workItems.nextAction: Finish canonical transport, secure membership/device readiness and meaningful sender/recipient acceptance; retain exact-ID retries and no plaintext downgrade.

workItems.title: Current independent CodeQL/crypto review
workItems.evidence: Exact scan of 3f3a0314 reported 54 findings and CODEQL_REVIEW_STALE; all 54 safe locations/fingerprints and the 90-day SARIF archive are retained. No independent approval is asserted.
workItems.nextAction: Export exact-SHA SARIF, triage each occurrence, fix confirmed defects and obtain actual independent review bound to current source.

workItems.title: Shopping Room purpose and decision guidance
workItems.evidence: Canonical Room UI now has welcome, scoped empty states and comparison guidance matching sharing identity. Runtime/visual acceptance is deferred.
workItems.nextAction: Review/render when Messages is ready; confirm controls still follow native membership and privacy.

workItems.title: Preserve security review input
workItems.evidence: Fail-closed review gate retained. Actual exact-source scan of 3f3a0314 archived SARIF for 90 days, artifact 11831752409; safe input index retains all 54 findings without approving them.
workItems.nextAction: Confirm artifact from a completed run and archive the reviewed packet before retention expires.

workItems.title: Durable status ledger and resumption index
workItems.evidence: Markdown report, full 106-section machine-readable coverage and static inspector prepared in repository.
workItems.nextAction: Keep the report current after every meaningful implementation or acceptance change.

workItems.title: Operations and independent security handoff
workItems.evidence: Runbook identifies canonical reports, replay boundaries, rollback, staged exercise matrix and current review inputs. No monitoring or reminders activated.
workItems.nextAction: Assign operational ownership and calibrate alerts against real observations.

workItems.title: Real Product Share loop acceptance
workItems.evidence: Public links and share UI have prior release evidence. Actual opted-in human opens/views/saves/messages and reshares remain unverified.
workItems.nextAction: Use the already consented bounded cohort; record canonical value and real observations; do not count opens or synthetic activity as conversions.

workItems.title: First Shopping Room and invite participation
workItems.evidence: User has no real Room yet. Canonical native invites, scoped preview and participation source exist; production signing/configuration/membership acceptance not established.
workItems.nextAction: Confirm native readiness and invite capabilities, create a real Room, verify scope/revoke/expiry/block/idempotency, then actual vote/comment/product participation.

workItems.title: Marketplace and supply-resolution value
workItems.evidence: Canonical Demand/Opportunity/response/resolution and liquidity reports exist. Causal production resolution and seller quality value are not observed here.
workItems.nextAction: Verify legitimate N=1 evidence/confidence, nonself seller responses, relevant supply and buyer resolution; keep growth, Search and Ads separate.

workItems.title: Operational routing, metrics and alerts
workItems.evidence: Canonical admin reports, bounded retries/DLQ/reconciliation and client timings exist. Scrape integration, baselines, alert ownership and regional targets are not accepted.
workItems.nextAction: Use read-only reports, establish baseline/targets, then approve bounded replay and alerts without private payloads.

workItems.title: Staging load, outage and abuse acceptance
workItems.evidence: Earlier bounded fixtures are historical evidence. No viral-scale, provider-outage or real-device exercise performed in this work.
workItems.nextAction: Use approved isolated staging with explicit budgets and cancellation; run replay, cache loss, signed membership races and protection matrix.

workItems.title: Mature acquisition, retention and network quality
workItems.evidence: Per-loop cohorts exist; real D1/D7/D30 windows and causal utility are unknown, not zero.
workItems.nextAction: Observe genuinely acquired cohorts after consented activation; wait for maturity and report value, abuse and opt-outs separately.

workItems.title: Future features remain intentionally scoped
workItems.evidence: Guest votes/comments, incentives, full contacts integration, generic rewards, creator collaborations and A/B systems are not V1 requirements to fabricate.
workItems.nextAction: Only implement if product policy and an explicit future scope require it; protect consent, review integrity and safety.

workItems.title: Full Growth Loops production declaration
workItems.evidence: Source coverage, deployment success and synthetic cases do not satisfy section 106. Messages/security/live/ops/capacity/retention evidence remain open.
workItems.nextAction: Close actual mandatory acceptance gates and retain rollback evidence before scaling or declaring production-ready.
